cooldown.reason: The official dated plans URL returns HTTP 200 and Livewire product-card templates, but its server response contains no product identifiers, room identifiers, prices, or canonical product text. The existing browser adapter previously timed out waiting for populated cards.
cooldown.retry_condition: Do not retry this exact flow until the public server response contains real product data, the documented browser flow materially changes, or the hotel adopts a supported booking engine.

decision: Keep the official adapter disabled, do not publish official rows from CSS markers, and continue using only independently verified OTA snapshots outside market KPIs until a complete official product flow exists.
